$comment: Generated from RunReport's Zod schemas, held to its type in src/view/report/types.ts by `pnpm schema:update`; don't edit. The RunReport behind a run's summary.md: <run>/report.json in the history folder or .reeval/runs.
title: RunReport

prompts.description: Distinct first-turn prompt hashes over the arm's attempts.

costPerSuccess.description: Total counted cost divided by passing attempts; null when cost unreported or 0 passes.

costPerSuccessDelta.description: Percentage delta of costPerSuccess against baseline; null on baseline or when either side is null.

k.description: Explicit trial count `k` when Pass@k / Pass^k were requested.

passAtK.description: Unweighted mean of unbiased per-task Pass@k when every task has `n >= k`.

passHatK.description: Unweighted mean of unbiased per-task Pass^k when every task has `n >= k`.

passKOmitted.description: Reason Pass@k and Pass^k were omitted on this arm when `k` was requested and some task has `n < k`.

rate.description: Pooled pass rate across counted attempts on this arm.

taskLift.description: Equal-weight cross-task point lift against baseline when more than 1 task ran; null on baseline.

taskRate.description: Equal-weight mean pass rate across tasks when more than 1 task ran.

verdict.description: Pass-rate certainty only; measure direction lives in measure cells.

cells.description: One entry per column key; every column present.

AttemptFacts.description: What one attempt's transcript shows it did, counted from its classified tool calls.

contextFiles.description: Each placed context file its calls read, directly or through a glob, in order of first read.

skills.description: Each skill its calls used, by where it came from, in order of first use.

firstLine.description: The transcript line of its first use, from 1.

diff.description: Lines exclude lockfiles; null counts print `not recorded`.

facts.description: What its transcript shows it did, from the report's `facts`; absent when the report had none for it, such as a passing attempt whose transcript `evidence` didn't keep.

href.description: The target every `AttemptRef` to this attempt uses.

judgments.description: The attempt's judge calls, in call order, labeled as `JudgeRow.label`.

gated.description: Whether a `toPass` assertion gated on it.

time.description: Where the attempt's time went, by phase, and the agent's turns by what they waited on.

agent.description: Null when no turn split its time.

usage.description: The tokens `tokens` adds up; null when the harness reported none, absent before it.

reasoning.description: Of `output`; null when the harness doesn't say.

id.description: The display label, `A1..AN`, numbered over the evals the report covers.

key.description: The attempt's `AttemptRecord.key`, the same in every report of its run.

costPerSuccess.description: Total counted cost divided by passing attempts; null when cost unreported or 0 passes.

k.description: Explicit trial count `k` when Pass@k / Pass^k were requested.

keys.description: One value per axis, repeated on every row.

passAtK.description: Unweighted mean of unbiased per-task Pass@k when every task has `n >= k`.

passHatK.description: Unweighted mean of unbiased per-task Pass^k when every task has `n >= k`.

passKOmitted.description: Reason Pass@k and Pass^k were omitted when `k` was requested and some task has `n < k`.

rate.description: Pooled pass rate across counted attempts in this group.

taskRate.description: Equal-weight mean pass rate across tasks when more than 1 task ran.

prior.description: `priorPassed` as text when set, else the comparison's own value.

priorPassed.description: The prior run's counted attempts that passed; null when the row has no counts.

reason.description: Why the check was n/a when known (`expect.skip` reason); null otherwise.

options.description: Sorted by count, then by first appearance.

picks.description: Each option's count out of the row's attempts, in `options` order.

ContrastRow.description: `from` against `to` on one coding harness and sandbox: each pair has a row per harness (and sandbox), whose interval is over that cell's attempts alone.

brokenTasks.description: Tasks where `from` scored 0% on multi-task evaluations; omitted when none or single-task.

harness.description: The coding harness both cells ran on; absent in reports built before it.

sandbox.description: The sandbox both cells ran in.

taskDelta.description: Equal-weight cross-task point delta (`from` minus `to`) when more than 1 task ran.

verdictScope.description: `pass-rate` when the contrast is on pass rate; else the measure's own direction.

sources.description: For a skill, the attempts that found it by where the skill they checked came from, its first use in the report's `facts`: one source an attempt, so the counts sum to at most `found`. An attempt counts in none when it has no facts, when its passing `toHaveCalledSkill` had a label of its own (which doesn't name the skill), when the check that found it was a `not.`, or when the matcher passed on a call the facts leave out (a failed call, or a file under `skills/<name>/` that isn't its `SKILL.md`). Empty without facts.

costPerSuccess.description: Total counted cost divided by passing attempts; null when cost unreported or 0 passes.

costPerSuccessDelta.description: Percentage delta of costPerSuccess against this harness's baseline; null on baseline or when either side is null.

harness.description: A harness label, or `Median` for the cross-harness row.

k.description: Explicit trial count `k` when Pass@k / Pass^k were requested.

passAtK.description: Unweighted mean of unbiased per-task Pass@k when every task has `n >= k`.

passHatK.description: Unweighted mean of unbiased per-task Pass^k when every task has `n >= k`.

passKOmitted.description: Reason Pass@k and Pass^k were omitted when `k` was requested and some task has `n < k`.

rate.description: Pooled pass rate for this harness and arm.

taskRate.description: Equal-weight mean pass rate across tasks when more than 1 task ran.

foot.description: Sample size, harness count, interval, and floor, as sentences.

kicker.description: What differed (`Revised skill against the JS SDK baseline`); null on a task eval.

saturated.description: True when every arm in a pass/fail comparison hit 100% across all tasks.

task.description: The eval's name: the heading above the headline.

anchor.description: GFM slug of the eval's heading.

name.description: Unique in the report; `<name> (<file>)` when two evals share a name.

primary.description: Null on a check-free eval, whose first choice, judge, or measure block leads.

medianTokens.description: Over the eval's counted attempts, every arm's on an A/B eval.

primary.description: The eval's headline in one cell, in its native unit: `result` as text.

result.description: The headline as numbers; absent in reports built before it.

taskRate.description: Equal-weight cross-task pass rate [0, 1] when more than 1 task ran.

baselineTaskRate.description: Equal-weight cross-task baseline pass rate [0, 1] when more than 1 task ran.

points.description: Pass-rate points as a fraction (`1` is +100 pts), with its 95% interval.

variantTaskRate.description: Equal-weight cross-task variant pass rate [0, 1] when more than 1 task ran.

median.description: Null when no attempt reported it.

count.description: Members of the eval's counted attempts.

line.description: `text` with `fix` as one plain line (`… Fix at evals/a.eval.ts:12: set runs: 4.`).

Figure.description: A displayed number: `value` for charts, `text` as every surface prints it (`461k`, `1m 05s`, `not reported`).

k.description: Explicit trial count `k` when Pass@k / Pass^k were requested.

metric.description: Which pass/fail metric leads when explicitly configured.

outcome.description: Product outcome noun: passed (default), found, or used.

passAtK.description: Unweighted mean of unbiased per-task `1 - C(n - c, k) / C(n, k)` when every task has `n >= k`.

passHatK.description: Unweighted mean of unbiased per-task `C(c, k) / C(n, k)` when every task has `n >= k`.

passKOmitted.description: Reason Pass@k and Pass^k were omitted when `k` was requested (`needs k trials per task ...`).

rate.description: Pooled pass rate across gated counted attempts (default lead).

taskRate.description: Equal-weight mean pass rate across tasks when more than 1 task ran.

tasks.description: Distinct task count when more than 1 task ran.

baselinePassAtK.description: Baseline unweighted unbiased Pass@k when every task has `n >= k`.

baselinePassHatK.description: Baseline unweighted unbiased Pass^k when every task has `n >= k`.

baselineTaskRate.description: Equal-weight cross-task baseline pass rate when more than 1 task ran.

k.description: Explicit trial count `k` when Pass@k / Pass^k were requested.

metric.description: Which pass/fail metric leads when explicitly configured.

others.description: Every other variant, with its own interval; never dropped.

passAtKPoints.description: Variant minus baseline Pass@k points when both arms satisfy `n >= k`.

passHatKPoints.description: Variant minus baseline Pass^k points when both arms satisfy `n >= k`.

passKOmitted.description: Reason Pass@k and Pass^k were omitted when `k` was requested (`needs k trials per task ...`).

saturated.description: True when every arm hit 100% across all tasks.

taskPoints.description: Equal-weight cross-task point difference (`variant` minus `baseline`) when more than 1 task ran.

tasks.description: Distinct task count when more than 1 task ran.

variantPassAtK.description: Variant unweighted unbiased Pass@k when every task has `n >= k`.

variantPassHatK.description: Variant unweighted unbiased Pass^k when every task has `n >= k`.

variantTaskRate.description: Equal-weight cross-task variant pass rate when more than 1 task ran.

k.description: Explicit trial count `k` when Pass@k / Pass^k were requested.

metric.description: Which pass/fail metric leads when explicitly configured.

passAtK.description: Unweighted unbiased Pass@k across tasks when every task has `n >= k`.

passHatK.description: Unweighted unbiased Pass^k across tasks when every task has `n >= k`.

passKOmitted.description: Reason Pass@k and Pass^k were omitted when `k` was requested.

saturated.description: True when every arm hit 100% across all tasks.

taskRate.description: Equal-weight cross-task pass rate when more than 1 task ran.

tasks.description: Distinct task count when more than 1 task ran.

leadRole.description: When many answers collapse to one quote shown in the headline.

lead.description: First gated worse/fixed change, else first change row.

text.description: One plain sentence that names the metric it affects.

Interval.description: A 95% interval in the parent's unit. `text`: `+66 pts to +100 pts`.

assertion.description: The `expect(verdict).toPass()` label that gates on it; null for a diagnostic judgment.

atOrAbove.description: Null when `threshold` is null (diagnostic): omit from "At or above".

scores.description: Each score behind `spread`, one per judge call; absent in reports built before it.

verdict.description: The judge's own verdict on its threshold.

lower.description: `3 of 4` harnesses lower than the baseline; null on the baseline.

Proportion.description: A proportion as its counts, `k` of `n`; a renderer derives the rate, interval and text.

themes.description: From the analysis; null without one.

whatChanged.description: Experimental inputs that changed (`stackChanges` / config), not outcome rows.

cost.description: Null when no attempt or judge call has a cost.

total.description: Labeled total when agent and judge are both present; else null.

runsPerCell.description: Null when cells ran different counts.

scope.description: Which runs this one is like-with-like with (`runScope`); unset in reports built before it.

tokens.description: `input + output + cacheRead + cacheWrite` (`totalTokens`); null when no attempt reported usage.

actions.description: From the analysis; empty without one.

integrity.description: Empty when clean; the block is then omitted.

roster.description: Empty unless `evals.length >= 2` and two or more harnesses ran.

single.description: `evals.length === 1`: the eval is the `#` title and every block moves up one level.

counted.description: Pass plus fail over gated cells: the pass-rate denominator.

reclassified.description: Of `infraError`: attempts an unhandled turn error moved out of pass or fail.

ungated.description: Ungated cells (baselines by default), never in `counted`.

k.description: Explicit trial count `k` when Pass@k / Pass^k were requested.

passAtK.description: Unbiased `1 - C(n - c, k) / C(n, k)` on this task when `n >= k`.

passHatK.description: Unbiased `C(c, k) / C(n, k)` on this task when `n >= k`.

passKOmitted.description: Reason Pass@k and Pass^k were omitted on this task when `n < k`.

costReported.description: True when at least one counted attempt reported USD cost.

k.description: Explicit trial count `k` when Pass@k / Pass^k were requested.

median.description: The cross-group median row; null with one group.

metric.description: Which pass/fail metric leads when explicitly configured.

passAtK.description: Overall unweighted unbiased Pass@k across tasks when every task has `n >= k`.

passHatK.description: Overall unweighted unbiased Pass^k across tasks when every task has `n >= k`.

passKOmitted.description: Reason Pass@k and Pass^k were omitted when `k` was requested and some task has `n < k`.

tasks.description: Per-task pass rates when more than 1 task ran.

cells.description: One entry per column key (coding harness on task evals, arm label on comparisons).

task.description: Stable task key (`CaseRecord.key` or prompt key).

total.description: Overall task score across gated/counted attempts on task evals; null on arm comparisons.

arms.description: Baseline first, then variants in declaration order.

costReported.description: True when at least one counted attempt reported USD cost.

k.description: Explicit trial count `k` when Pass@k / Pass^k were requested.

metric.description: Which pass/fail metric leads when explicitly configured.

saturated.description: True when every arm hit 100% across all tasks.

saturationNote.description: Plain-language saturation explanation when `saturated` is true; null otherwise.

tasks.description: Per-task pass rates by arm when more than 1 task ran.

uniformLead.description: Set when every arm passed every applicable assertion; `assertionsByArm` is then empty.
